intent: Fond pro dérivé du paysage Malaisie du mode créateur, avec correspondance des reliefs pour un match cut et une paire de thèmes clair/sombre.
geometry: Les courbes des terrasses et les trois grandes verticales servent de points de correspondance. L’édition générative reprend la composition, sans garantir une identité pixel à pixel.
usage: Conserver le même ratio, cadrage et object-position entre le paysage créateur et ces fonds. Ces images sont des fonds pleins ; une parallaxe entre reliefs nécessitera des calques séparés.

variants.title: Univers minéral — nuit
variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: standalone website hero background, NIGHT version of a geometrically matched pair.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET and exact COMPOSITION BLUEPRINT. This is the Malaysian landscape currently used in the creator section. Transform its world into a beautiful extraterrestrial landscape for the professional section. The two will be crossfaded in a MATCH CUT: keeping the position and contour of the main shapes matters more than inventing a new composition.
Primary request: Turn the Malaysian rice terraces and city into a majestic, subtle, photorealistic cosmic landscape while tracing the SAME TERRACE CONTOURS, SAME skyline peak positions, SAME camera, SAME perspective, SAME horizon and SAME overall balance.
Spatial invariants: Keep the landscape framing and 16:9 aspect ratio of the input, edge to edge. Preserve the nested horizontal S-curves of the terrace ridges in their exact original positions, particularly the large oval terrace field at center-right, the descending terraces at middle-left and the curling foreground furrows at lower-right. Preserve the central-right hill's original silhouette, the middle-left valley, distant background ridge, and foreground mass placement. Do not replace these with a generic canyon, planet horizon or a new valley. Do not pan, crop, rotate, zoom or change lens.
World transformation: Every cultivated terrace becomes a naturally sculpted shelf of ancient blue-grey lunar slate and fine regolith, with the same contour line. Natural pale mineral seams delicately catch light along some ridge edges, no artificial glowing grid. The original dense tree clumps become weathered low basalt outcrops and dark rock clusters, maintaining the same distribution and approximate mass silhouettes rather than literal stone trees. The central skyline becomes a distant group of slender eroded mineral needles at exactly the old tower positions and heights, with a few lower rock blocks replacing the low buildings. The tall needle around x=35% and the two distinct peaks around x=51% and x=62% are important visual anchors. Remove all recognizable modern buildings, vegetation, roads and agricultural color.
Sky: The same skyline opening, now an atmospheric midnight blue sky with a restrained number of tiny distant stars. A very faint enormous planetary arc is tucked into the existing cloud shape at the upper right; its pale contour should not create a new dominant focal point. Fine blue particulate haze between relief layers, deep spatial recession, no spaceships or people.
Art direction: Cinema-quality photoreal landscape, tactile stratified stone, vast scale, photographic depth. A believable surreal world, not vector art or a videogame screenshot. Desaturated navy #111A2C, blue slate, restrained pale cyan edge light, subtle silver highlights. Dark but with legible texture and three clear depth planes. Left lower 45% stays quiet and low contrast for ivory serif title added later; the upper center and side edges carry environmental detail. The right third will receive a portrait in the website, so avoid a bright flare or central graphic there. No text, logos, UI, portrait, frame, letterboxing or watermarks.
Constraints: A single complete landscape image, not a comparison, not a collage, not two panels. Output ONLY the transformed nighttime background, at the same wide 16:9 composition, preferably 1600x900.

variants.title: Univers minéral — aube
variants.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: LIGHT THEME companion to the attached dark website hero background.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET. This is the approved composition blueprint of the NIGHT background. Create its exact DAY / pale dawn counterpart, changing ONLY lighting, exposure, atmospheric color and color grade.
Primary request: Show this exact extraterrestrial terraced landscape in a beautifully soft pearlescent dawn, suitable behind charcoal typography on a warm ivory website.
ABSOLUTE GEOMETRY LOCK: Keep every rock, terrace edge, ridge, distant mountain contour, foreground outcrop and all three thin mineral spires in exactly the same position, shape, scale and perspective. Same pixel framing, same horizon, same camera, same 16:9 aspect ratio. Do not add, remove, redesign, move or crop any physical element. This pair will be crossfaded directly during a theme switch, so the landscape must not jump. The distant moon/planet arc at upper-right remains in the same place, becoming subtly visible through the pale atmosphere; stars naturally become almost invisible in dawn light.
LIGHT VERSION art direction: Delicate high-key mineral landscape of pale limestone, silver-grey slate, very pale desaturated icy blue, chalk and warm pearl. Mist between the same relief layers preserves cinematic atmospheric depth. A pale powder-blue sky with ivory clouds and a whisper of warm cream illumination from the upper left, echoing the warmth of the Malaysian source landscape while remaining extraterrestrial. Extremely refined contrast, light but tangible surface texture, no bright neon accents, no blue-black sky, no hard noon shadows, no fake negative or inverted colors. The pale terrain is natural dawn illumination, NOT a white translucent layer pasted over the night image. The lower-left 45% is softly lit, light and low-contrast so charcoal serif website text can be placed over it. Blend the extreme lower edge gently toward warm off-white #F5F3EF, while preserving the existing shape contours.
Style: Premium photographic film production design, vast space, tactile stone, believable reflected light, calm and luminous, beautiful to look at. Keep enough separation between foreground, midground and distance for future parallax layers.
Constraints: Change ONLY lighting/color/time of day. Output a single complete standalone LIGHT background. No text, UI, logos, people, portrait, border, collage or side-by-side comparison. Match the exact source image dimensions and wide framing.
